sources.title: NIST SP 811 Appendix B.9
sources.notes: Use 453.59237 g per avoirdupois pound; U.S. cup 236.5882 ml and tablespoon 14.78676 ml are published rounded factors. A 16-ounce mass package is one pound.

sources.title: King Arthur ingredient weight chart

sources.title: SmartCart pilot simulation policy
sources.notes: All product names, pack options, prices, availability, and dietary states are designed examples. No store prices, brand products, or Instacart SKU matches are claimed.

sources.title: NIST SP 811 Appendix B.8/B.9 (teaspoon and avoirdupois ounce)
sources.notes: U.S. teaspoon 4.928922 ml; avoirdupois ounce 28.349523125 g (exact, 1/16 lb). Can and package sizes stated in ounces are treated as net mass.

sources.title: King Arthur Baking ingredient weight chart
sources.notes: Rows used (volume = grams): all-purpose flour 1 cup = 120; sugar 1 cup = 198; brown sugar packed 1 cup = 213; butter 1/2 cup = 113; grated cheddar/jack 1 cup = 113; grated Parmesan 1/2 cup = 50; sour cream 1 cup = 227; yogurt 1 cup = 227; mayonnaise 1/2 cup = 113; oats 1 cup = 89; cornstarch 1/4 cup = 28; dried breadcrumbs 1/4 cup = 28; long-grain rice dry 1/2 cup = 99; cooked brown rice 1 cup = 170; diced onions 1 cup = 142; baking powder 1 tsp = 4; minced garlic 2 tbsp = 28. Reference estimates, not measured densities.

sources.title: SmartCart recipe-line resolution policy
sources.notes: Project policy, not a measurement standard: dash = 1/8 tsp and pinch = 1/16 tsp; ranges use the upper bound; 'X or Y' uses the first option; lines marked optional are excluded; one recipe bunch of green onions equals the catalog bunch of 6 stalks.

sources.title: SmartCart full-catalog simulation policy
sources.notes: All product names, house brands, pack sizes, prices, availability and dietary states are designed for an offline study. No store prices, real brand products or Instacart SKU matches are claimed.
